name: dineos-widget
description: Build tooling for the embeddable DineOS ordering widget. Source lives in src/widget/; the build bundles it into a single minified static/widget.js (IIFE, no deps) plus a sourcemap, so the embed stays plug-and-play.

scripts.build:dev: esbuild src/widget/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es5 --outfile=static/widget.js --banner:js="/* DineOS widget — dev bundle. Edit src/widget/*.js, then run `npm run build`. */"
scripts.check: npm run check:bundle && npm run test
